title: bourreria havanensis var. radula
intro: Bourreria havanensis var. radula, commonly known as Cuban snake root, is a plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, acting as an antioxidant, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bourreria havanensis var. radula include modulating the immune system, reducing pain and fever, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
